categories.main_business_segments: The company focuses on three main business segments: smart city IoT, intelligent sensors, and industrial IoT. The smart city IoT segment primarily includes IoT smart gas meters and related terminal products. The intelligent sensors segment involves R&D, production, and sales of temperature sensors, magnetic sensors, pressure sensors, and related components. The industrial IoT segment provides platforms and solutions for smart manufacturing, smart factories, and cloud manufacturing, currently in early development stages.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 13 core technologies including mechanical metering, shell sealing, temperature conversion, electronic metering, intelligent control, low power consumption, information security, and ultrasonic gas flow measurement. It employs integrated structural design and full-process manufacturing for smart gas meters, and vertical integration from materials to components in sensor production. The company uses advanced industrial IoT platforms for digitalized smart manufacturing and has obtained multiple patents and certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized gas groups, water utility companies, automotive manufacturers, home appliance companies, and industrial clients. The company serves domestic markets extensively and is expanding export sales, especially in Colombia. Its products are applied in natural gas metering, water metering, automotive electronics, home appliances, and low-altitude aircraft sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide sales and service network covering major cities and regions. It has production bases in Chengdu, Meishan, and Chongqing. Export markets are being actively developed, with significant growth in overseas gas meter sales, particularly in Colombia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of IoT smart meters and sensors. It controls core component production such as sensitive elements for sensors and integrates upstream materials processing with downstream product assembly and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in smart city IoT, intelligent sensors, and industrial IoT platforms. The company emphasizes innovation in sensor materials and manufacturing, expanding product lines to include temperature, magnetic, and pressure sensors. It invests heavily in platform development for smart gas and water management and industrial IoT solutions, aiming to enhance digitalization and automation in manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of IoT smart gas meters, smart water meters, intelligent sensors, and related IoT platforms. The company also earns income from software and platform services, government subsidies, and export sales. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels with some distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the few domestic firms with integrated design and manufacturing capabilities for both base meters and smart control units in the smart gas meter industry. It holds a leading position in China’s smart gas meter and sensor markets, supported by extensive patents, certifications, and recognized technology standards. Competition is intense, especially in smart gas meters, with pressure on prices and margins.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 320.5 million, a slight decline of 1.99% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 65.2 million, reflecting increased R&D and production costs in new business segments. The intelligent sensor segment grew rapidly by over 400%, becoming a key growth driver. The company maintains significant R&D investment at about 20% of revenue and has a workforce of 947 employees, including 202 in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced technology integration, high precision metering, intelligent control, and information security in its products. Its smart gas meters feature integrated design ensuring reliability and safety, while its sensor business offers vertical integration from materials to components, enabling cost and quality advantages. The industrial IoT platform provides comprehensive digital management solutions, supporting smart manufacturing and operational efficiency. The company’s strong patent portfolio and standard-setting role further differentiate its offerings.
